paper.title: PaperAudit-Bench: Benchmarking Error Detection in Research Papers for Critical Automated Peer Review

subset.rule: 全部 220 篇（gpt-5 注入）；数据集里 o4-mini 的注入文件和 NeurIPS 子集另有的六个合成模型的文件不用。阶段三的训练题和留出题由 #157 选。

sections:
## 共同的问题

| 编号 | 问题 | 证据 | 影响 | 处理 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| C1 | 判官看不到被测系统拿到的材料，也看不到系统自己的代码和产出 | PaperWritingBench 的 SxS 只读两篇论文（官方 `sxs_paper_quality.py`、`sxs_lit_review_quality.py`）；PaperWrite-Bench 的幻觉检查只拿原论文 LaTeX 对照（`evaluate_per_section.py` 的 pass 1）；ResearchClawBench 的判官只读报告、checklist 和图（`evaluation/score.py`） | 系统自己补出的方法细节、记错方法的数字、没有代码算过的数字都发现不了，有时还被当作优点加分（P1） | 新增 `faithfulness-judge`：逐条核对文档对自身工作的陈述与材料（和评测侧的参照）是否一致。验证见 P1、W3、R1 |
| C2 | 判官模型被替换，且去掉了采样参数 | Gemini `gemini-3.1-pro-preview` 由 Antigravity 以 `gemini-4-argon-high` 服务；GPT 判官（`gpt-4o`、`gpt-5`、`gpt-5.1`、`gpt-5.4`）由 codex-api 以 `gpt-5.6-sol`、effort medium 服务；`temperature`、`top_p` 被去掉（`codex_api.toml`） | 判官的宽严和波动可能与官方不同 | 每条分数记录实际服务的模型。替代判官有锚点：PaperWritingBench 原论文对其逐字节副本的 SxS 8 次全平（#42 调查）；ScienceAgentBench 图像判官对全部图像题做了 gold、他题 gold、空白三种锚点（S5）；ResearchClawBench 同一报告重复打分（R5） |
| C3 | 一次打分会波动 | ResearchClawBench 同一份报告五次打分在 23.7 和 29.3 之间（R5）；PaperWrite-Bench 同一份论文（运行 R2）重新打分，rubric 3.56 变 3.61、重大幻觉 1 条变 4 条、claim 241 条变 227 条（本 Issue）；PaperWritingBench 同一篇论文（运行 `…-20261028T002600Z`）的文献综述 #42 打 58 / 57（Gemini / GPT），本 Issue 重新打分 51 / 52；SxS 的胜负两次相同 | 单题、单次的差几分不说明问题 | ResearchClawBench 每次打分另打 2 次，报告均值、标准差和极差（`project_checks.repeats`）；其余两项单次打分要 20 次以上调用，只在汇总上比较 |
| C4 | 离线题不是完全断网：屏蔽放行 Python 包索引 | PaperWrite-Bench 的官方写作 agent 没有网络工具，ASI-Bench 榜单页写“没有外部工具访问”，PhysClosureBench 的 `network_access` 是 `disabled`；本项目这三个 benchmark 的题目以 `offline` 屏蔽运行，另放行 `pypi.org/simple/` 和 `files.pythonhosted.org/packages/` 的 `GET`/`HEAD`（设置 `shield.package_index`，每次运行的 `setup.network` 写 `package_index: allowed`，#105） | 被测系统能 pip 装包，官方 agent 不能；包索引不含题目答案，也不含论文内容，其他站点（文献、论文、代码托管、搜索）照旧 403，屏蔽表（原论文、仓库）先于放行生效 | 记入每次运行的记录和看板；不改官方评分；读离线题的结果时按此条理解联网条件 |

## PaperAudit-Bench（`paperaudit-judge`）

| 编号 | 问题 | 证据 | 影响 | 处理 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| A1 | 官方对发现的规范化会悄悄丢掉字段不全的发现 | `eval_detection.py` 的 `_normalize_findings` 要求 `type`、`section_location`、`error_location`、`explanation`、`proposed_fix` 都是非空字符串且 `confidence` 是数，否则整条丢弃；官方检测器自己的解析（`global_cross_section_review`）只要求位置、引文和解释，`proposed_fix` 可以为空 | coding agent 漏写 `proposed_fix` 的发现既不计入精确率的分母，也不会匹配任何错误 | 照官方；`project_checks.dropped_findings` 记交付了几条、保留几条、丢了几条 |
| A2 | 判官被替换 | 官方 `--eval_model gpt-5.1`；这里由 codex-api 服务的 `gpt-5.6-sol`（effort medium）；论文附录 B.2 的换判官实验：Claude-Sonnet-4.5 比 GPT-5.1 宽松（同一批结果的 Macro-F1 59.5 对 41.4 到 60.6 对 40.6），检测器排名不变 | 绝对分与论文不可直接比；宽严与官方不同 | 每条分数的 `judge` 记实际服务的模型和用量；只在同一批篇上比较系统，不与论文的数字相减 |
| A3 | 匹配是多对多，一条宽泛的发现可以同时抓到多个错误 | 判官提示的规则：“Many-to-many is allowed: a single gt_index may match multiple pred_indices, and a single pred_index may be matched by multiple gt_indices”；`precision` 用的是被匹配的发现下标的并集，不检查下标是否在发现数范围内 | 几条笼统的跨章节“数字不一致”类发现可能抓到多处错误，抬高 EC；越界下标会让 FP 超过 1（官方代码没有截断） | 官方分数照录；该影响未测量，读结果时同时看 `findings` 条数和 `matched_findings` |
| A4 | 发现越多 FP 越低，官方提示又要求“尽量穷尽” | 官方全文审阅提示：“Be exhaustive: include every valid issue you can find”；FP = 对上的发现数 / 全部发现数 | 为覆盖率多报的运行会被 FP 拉低；F1 因此奖励在两者之间取舍好的运行，而不是只会多报的 | 按官方；同时报告 EC 和 FP |

判官被替换（A2）属于共同问题 C2；没有重复打分（C3），单篇 F1 只有一次判官结果，比较系统看多篇的 Macro-F1。

## Shared problems

| id | problem | evidence | impact | handling |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| C1 | The judges see neither the material the system was given nor the system's own code and outputs | PaperWritingBench's SxS reads two papers only (official `sxs_paper_quality.py`, `sxs_lit_review_quality.py`); PaperWrite-Bench's hallucination check compares with the original LaTeX only (pass 1 of `evaluate_per_section.py`); ResearchClawBench's judge reads the report, the checklist and images only (`evaluation/score.py`) | Method details the system made up, numbers credited to the wrong method and numbers no code computed go unnoticed, and are sometimes rewarded (P1) | New `faithfulness-judge`: every statement the document makes about its own work is checked against the materials (and an evaluator-side reference). Validation in P1, W3, R1 |
| C2 | The judge models are replaced, with sampling parameters removed | Gemini `gemini-3.1-pro-preview` is served by Antigravity as `gemini-4-argon-high`; the GPT judges (`gpt-4o`, `gpt-5`, `gpt-5.1`, `gpt-5.4`) are served by codex-api as `gpt-5.6-sol`, effort medium; `temperature` and `top_p` are removed (`codex_api.toml`) | A judge's strictness and spread may differ from the official one | Every score records the served model. The substitutes have anchors: PaperWritingBench's SxS of the original against a byte-identical copy of itself gave 8 ties in 8 (the #42 investigation); ScienceAgentBench's figure judge was run with gold, other-task gold and blank predictions on every figure task (S5); ResearchClawBench scores the same report again (R5) |
| C3 | One scoring varies | ResearchClawBench: five scorings of the same report lie between 23.7 and 29.3 (R5); PaperWrite-Bench: the same paper (run R2) scored again moved the rubric from 3.56 to 3.61, major hallucinations from 1 to 4 and claims from 241 to 227 (this Issue); PaperWritingBench: the same paper (run `…-20261028T002600Z`) got literature-review scores of 58 / 57 (Gemini / GPT) in #42 and 51 / 52 when scored again in this Issue; the SxS outcomes were the same both times | A difference of a few points on one item and one scoring means nothing | ResearchClawBench scores every report 2 more times and reports mean, standard deviation and range (`project_checks.repeats`); the other two need 20+ calls per scoring and are compared over many items only |
| C4 | Offline items are not fully cut off: the shield lets the Python package index through | PaperWrite-Bench's official writing agent has no network tools, the ASI-Bench leaderboard page says "no external tool access", PhysClosureBench's `network_access` is `disabled`; here the items of these three benchmarks run with the `offline` shield and additionally let through `GET`/`HEAD` on `pypi.org/simple/` and `files.pythonhosted.org/packages/` (setting `shield.package_index`; every run's `setup.network` states `package_index: allowed`, #105) | The systems under test can install packages with pip and the official agents cannot; the package index holds neither the item's answer nor the paper's content, every other site (literature, papers, code hosting, search) is still 403, and the list rules (original paper, repositories) win over the exception | Recorded in every run's record and on the dashboard; the official scoring is unchanged; read an offline item's result with this network condition in mind |

## PaperAudit-Bench (`paperaudit-judge`)

| ID | Problem | Evidence | Effect | Handling |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| A1 | The official normalisation of findings silently drops findings with missing fields | `_normalize_findings` in `eval_detection.py` needs `type`, `section_location`, `error_location`, `explanation` and `proposed_fix` to be non-empty strings and `confidence` a number, else the finding is dropped; the official detector's own parser (`global_cross_section_review`) only needs the location, the quote and the explanation, and `proposed_fix` may be empty | A finding of a coding agent that omits `proposed_fix` neither counts in the precision denominator nor matches any error | As official; `project_checks.dropped_findings` records how many findings were delivered, kept and dropped |
| A2 | The judge is replaced | Officially `--eval_model gpt-5.1`; here `gpt-5.6-sol` served by codex-api (effort medium); the paper's judge-swap experiment (Appendix B.2): Claude-Sonnet-4.5 is more permissive than GPT-5.1 (Macro-F1 of the same results 59.5 vs 41.4 up to 60.6 vs 40.6), the detector ranking is unchanged | Absolute scores are not directly comparable with the paper; the strictness differs from the official one | Each score's `judge` records the served model and usage; systems are compared on the same papers only and not against the paper's numbers |
| A3 | Matching is many-to-many, so one broad finding can capture several errors | The judge prompt rule: "Many-to-many is allowed: a single gt_index may match multiple pred_indices, and a single pred_index may be matched by multiple gt_indices"; `precision` uses the union of matched finding indices without checking that they lie within the number of findings | A few vague cross-section "numbers do not agree" findings may capture many errors and raise EC; an out-of-range index would push FP above 1 (the official code does not clip) | Official score recorded as is; the effect is not measured; read the number of findings and `matched_findings` with the score |
| A4 | More findings lower FP, while the official prompt asks to be exhaustive | Official full-text review prompt: "Be exhaustive: include every valid issue you can find"; FP = matching findings / all findings | A run that over-reports for coverage is pulled down by FP; F1 rewards a good trade-off, not mere over-reporting | As official; EC and FP are reported together |

The replaced judge (A2) is common problem C2; scores are not repeated (C3), a paper's F1 is one judge result, and systems are compared on the Macro-F1 over many papers.

    arxiv: 2601.19916

run:
  harness: 官方检测器 detect/mas_error_detection.py（三种模式：fast 单次全文审阅、standard、deep 多 agent），评估 detect/eval_detection.py
  stages:
    - stage: 1_detection
      input: "合成论文 paper_synth_<注入模型>.json 的 paper.content：按序的文本块和 base64 图片块，每块带序号和章节标签；fast 模式的全文审阅提示 = PromptTemplates.global_system() + 引导行 + 全部块（最多 64 张图）"
      output: "一个 JSON 对象，键 findings，每条恰有 type、section_location、error_location、explanation、confidence、proposed_fix"
      source: detect/agents.py（global_cross_section_review、build_global_user_parts） ; detect/prompts.py
    - stage: 2_evaluation
      method: "LLM 判官对每个 GT 错误判断是否被某条发现抓到（build_match_prompt，输出 matches），每篇：EC = 抓到的 GT 数 / GT 数，FP = 被匹配的发现数 / 发现数，F1 = 二者调和平均；论文报告各篇 F1 的平均（Macro-F1）"
      judge: "GPT-5.1（论文）；判官换成 Gemini-2.5-Pro、Claude-Sonnet-4.5 会改变绝对分，不改变检测器排名（论文附录 B.2）"
      source: detect/eval_detection.py ; 论文 4.1、附录 B.2
  ground_truth: "合成文件 audit_log.edits 里 apply_results 标 applied 的编辑（section_location = location，error_location = target_find，explanation = error_explanation）；mas_error_detection.py 的 _extract_ground_truth_from_synth"
  commands:
    install: "git clone https://github.com/TU2021/PaperAudit && git checkout de7582b188ca2d867298de978386ec1f5085806f && pip install -r requirements.txt"
    detect: "python mas_error_detection.py --root_dir <papers> --detect_mode fast --detect_model <m> --synth_model gpt-5-2025-08-07 --enable-global-review"
    evaluate: "python eval_detection.py --root_dir <papers> --detect_model <m> --synth_model gpt-5-2025-08-07 --eval_mode fast --eval_model gpt-5.1"
  official_time_limits: "没有：官方是对每篇的若干次 API 调用。"
  dependencies:
    packages: "评分只需要 openai 和仓库 detect/ 下的 utils.py、eval_detection.py（标准库 + openai）"
    source: detect/utils.py ; detect/eval_detection.py
  gpu: 不需要。
  external_services:
    - "判官：OpenAI 兼容端点（本项目经 codex-api）"

subset:
  rule: "全部 220 篇（gpt-5 注入）；数据集里 o4-mini 的注入文件和 NeurIPS 子集另有的六个合成模型的文件不用。阶段三的训练题和留出题由 #157 选。"
  count_verified: 220
  formal_batch:
    rule: "没有正式批次：本 benchmark 是阶段三审稿岗位的训练环境（#141、#157），题目由 #157 选定。"
  budget:
    per_task_cap: "无：官方没有时限；本项目不设自己的上限，只受框架统一的一周上限约束。"
    judge_calls: "每篇一次（没有有效发现就不调用）"
    resources: "CPU 即可；每篇 paper.md 约几十 KB 到 1 MB，加几张到几十张图"

task_interface:
  reference: "paperaudit/<iclr25|icml25|neurips25>_<OpenReview 编号>，见 items"
  renderer: src/researchworld_eval/benchmarks/paperaudit.py
  prompt: "SYSTEM.md = PromptTemplates.global_system() 原文（固定 commit 的函数输出）；TASK.md = 官方全文审阅的引导行原文，后接一段只说路径的话：论文是 /work/paper/paper.md（图在 /work/paper/images/），答案写到 /work/findings.json"
  candidate: "/work/paper/paper.md（官方块流：每块一个 `[Block #N | type |Section: S]` 头，图片块写成指向 images/ 里文件的引用）和 /work/paper/images/（从 synth JSON 的 base64 解出的图），只读挂载"
  limits: {}   # 官方无时限，不设上限
  offline: true   # fast 模式的检测器没有联网工具，任务内只放行包索引
  remaining_differences: "coding agent 读文件、多次推理，官方是一次带全文的 API 调用；官方头在没有章节标签时写成 `textNone]`（笔误），这里省掉标签；官方一次最多送 64 张图并按字符预算截断全文，这里给全部；判官统一为 codex-api 服务的 GPT（官方 GPT-5.1）；论文里写着原标题和作者（官方也是），所以标题不作屏蔽关键词。"
  never_candidate: [audit_log, paper_synth 里的其他字段, 原论文 paper.pdf, reviews.json, metadata.json, 其他注入模型的文件, paper_final.json 和解析中间文件]
  deliverables: [findings.json]
  evaluator: paperaudit-judge   # 官方 eval_detection 的匹配；判官经 codex-api
  shield: src/tasks/benchmarks/paperaudit/shield.yaml   # 逐篇的 OpenReview 页、arXiv 页（查得到时）、数据集页和仓库
  real_runs:
    - {run: coding-agent-paperaudit--iclr25_11848-20261101T190333Z, date: 2026-11-01, purpose: smoke, system: "coding-agent Claude Code + claude-sonnet-5-5 / high（条件 CC-sonnet）", elapsed_s: 169, equivalent_usd: 0.359, score: "F1 0.737（EC 14/15，FP 14/23）"}
    - {run: researchworld-paperaudit--iclr25_11848-20261101T190210Z, date: 2026-11-01, purpose: smoke, system: "ResearchWorld HuTian 4.2.0 + claude-sonnet-5-5 / high（条件 RW-sonnet）", elapsed_s: 1728, equivalent_usd: 3.822, score: "F1 0.508（EC 15/15，FP 15/44）"}

published_scores:
  read_date: 2026-11-01
  source: "论文 arXiv 2601.19916 表 7（附录 B.3）"
  scale: "Fast 模式，NeurIPS 子集 46 篇；每格 Macro-F1 / EC / FP（%），判官 GPT-5.1；下面是注入模型为 GPT-5 的那一列"
  judge: GPT-5.1
  models:
    - {detector: Gemini-2.5-Pro, macro_f1: 60.5, ec: 57.9, fp: 64.1}
    - {detector: GPT-5, macro_f1: 62.5, ec: 72.4, fp: 56.0}
    - {detector: Grok-4, macro_f1: 48.1, ec: 39.4, fp: 66.3}
    - {detector: Claude-4.5, macro_f1: 43.1, ec: 39.4, fp: 49.0}
    - {detector: Qwen3*, macro_f1: 45.7, ec: 43.3, fp: 49.6}   # * 非多模态
    - {detector: O4-Mini, macro_f1: 45.3, ec: 45.0, fp: 48.9}
    - {detector: GLM-4.6, macro_f1: 35.5, ec: 31.5, fp: 42.4}
  mismatches_vs_our_protocol:
    - "论文的表只覆盖 NeurIPS 46 篇；本项目的条目是 220 篇，只有在同一批篇上的 Macro-F1 才可比。"
    - "判官：本项目由 codex-api 服务的 GPT（gpt-5.6-sol）判全部条目，不再是 GPT-5.1；论文附录 B.2 说换判官会改变绝对分（Claude-Sonnet-4.5 更宽松）。"
    - "被测者是 coding agent 或 ResearchWorld，不是一次 API 调用。"

# 同时有 metadata.json 和 paper_synth_gpt-5-2025-08-07.json 的 220 个文件夹（ICLR_25 107、ICML_25 67、NeurIPS_25 46）；

# PaperAudit-Bench

[中文](README.md) | English

The machine-readable facts are in [`MANIFEST.yaml`](MANIFEST.yaml); this page says what a reader needs and points to where each fact sits in the manifest.

## What it is

PaperAudit-Bench measures whether a model can find errors that were deliberately injected into a paper: 220 oral papers of ICLR, ICML and NeurIPS 2025 are taken, an LLM injects about ten errors
into the whole text as edits (8 categories: evidence/data manipulation, method logic, experimental design, citations, exaggerated conclusions and so on, including ones only visible across sections),
and the tested party reads the altered paper and returns the problems it found, each with a category, a location (quoted from the text) and an explanation.
This project uses only the GPT-5 injection (the dataset also holds an o4-mini injection per paper, and six more models on the NeurIPS subset): 3258 applied errors in 220 papers (11 to 18 per paper)
(source: MANIFEST.yaml `source.papers`, `source.injected_errors`; paper arXiv 2601.19916).

- Paper: arXiv 2601.19916 (2026-01-07).
- Code: `TU2021/PaperAudit`, pinned commit `de7582b188ca2d867298de978386ec1f5085806f`; **the repository has no licence file**.
- Data: HF dataset `mayiwen/PaperAudit_Dataset`, pinned revision `5bfb78951414d014608aeb487992ad0665a6f607`, the card says Apache-2.0.
- Data entry in this repository: asset id `paperaudit-hf` (per paper of the three directories ICLR_25, ICML_25 and NeurIPS_25 only `metadata.json`, `paper_synth_gpt-5-2025-08-07.json`, `reviews.json` and `paper.pdf`, about 1.3 GB, deletable and rebuildable),
  read through the link `assets/paperaudit-hf` (source: `assets/MANIFEST.yaml`).

## Licence

The card says Apache-2.0, but the data republishes the papers' PDFs from OpenReview, the parsed full texts and the reviews (`reviews.json`), which are the content of the papers' authors and reviewers, and a label on the card cannot cover their rights;
the card does not say more per paper, and the code repository has no licence. This project did not check each paper; it uses them for research evaluation through the asset only, never commits or redistributes them, and reads only the prompts and scoring functions of the code repository
(source: MANIFEST.yaml `license`).

## Items and batches

The 220 papers are the manifest's `items`; an item name is `<iclr25|icml25|neurips25>_<OpenReview number>` (107 + 67 + 46), e.g. `paperaudit/iclr25_10203`.
`uv run researchworld_eval tasks --benchmark paperaudit` lists them.

**There is no formal batch**: it is a training environment of the phase 3 review role (internal-review) (#141, #157); #157 chooses the items. `src/tasks/batches/paperaudit.yaml` is the whole set and is not in `plan.batches`.
Resources: CPU only; one Markdown full text per paper (tens of KB to about 1 MB) and a few to a few dozen images.

## How it runs and is scored

- Official entry: `detect/mas_error_detection.py` has three modes (fast single-pass full-text review, standard with document memory and per-section review, deep multi-agent); evaluation is `detect/eval_detection.py` (source: MANIFEST.yaml `run`).
  This project corresponds to the full-text review of fast mode: system prompt `PromptTemplates.global_system()`, the user turn is the lead lines plus all blocks.
- Scoring: an LLM judge sees all injected errors and all findings and decides for each injected error whether some finding captures it (many-to-many allowed); per paper: Error Coverage EC = captured errors / errors, Finding Precision FP = matching findings / findings,
  F1 = their harmonic mean; the paper reports the mean of the per-paper F1 (Macro-F1). The official judge is GPT-5.1; this project uses the GPT served by codex-api (`gpt-5.6-sol`) and each score records the served model and usage.

## One item: what the system gets and how it is scored (Issue #159)

Written `paperaudit/<item>`; any container system can run it:

```bash
uv run researchworld_eval run coding-agent paperaudit/iclr25_11848 --condition CC-sonnet --purpose smoke
uv run researchworld_eval providers codex-api start
uv run researchworld_eval score paperaudit-judge <run-id> --credential codex=codex
```

- **Given (candidate side, rendered by `researchworld_eval.benchmarks.paperaudit`)**: `SYSTEM.md` is the official full-text review system prompt verbatim; `TASK.md` is the official lead lines verbatim followed by one paragraph that only names paths;
  the paper is the read-only mounted `/work/paper/paper.md` (the official block stream, one `[Block #N | type |Section: S]` header per block, image blocks written as references to files in `images/`) and `/work/paper/images/` (decoded from the base64 embedded in the synthetic file).
  The answer goes to `/work/findings.json`: a JSON object with the key `findings`, each finding with exactly `type`, `section_location`, `error_location`, `explanation`, `confidence`, `proposed_fix`.
- **Not given**: the `audit_log` of the synthetic file (the edit list, apply results, explanations), the original PDF, the reviews, the metadata, other injection models' files, parsing intermediates. Rendering reads only `paper.content`; the framework refuses a candidate side that holds a file with an evaluation-material name.
- **Deliverable**: `findings.json`.
- **Time limit**: officially none; this benchmark sets none of its own and only the framework-wide one-week cap applies.
- **Network shield**: the fast-mode detector has no web tools, so it is an offline item and only the package index is allowed (common problem C4); the shield ([`shield.yaml`](shield.yaml)) blocks the dataset page and the repository (the answers are in the synthetic files),
  the PaperAudit paper, and each original paper's OpenReview forum and PDF pages (`icml25_579` has no metadata record in the dataset; its two forums come from the public OpenReview search), and the arXiv page where an arXiv version was found (184 papers);
  the literature-search date cap is the earlier of the arXiv v1 and the OpenReview submission date. The paper prints its original title and authors (as officially), so the title is not a shield keyword.
- **Scoring**: the evaluator [`paperaudit-judge`](../../../evaluators/paperaudit_judge/README.en.md), headline `metrics.f1`, plus `detection_rate` (EC) and `precision` (FP).

### Differences from the official protocol

- The tested party is a coding agent with tools or ResearchWorld, not one API call; it can read the text in parts, look at the figures and check repeatedly.
- Officially at most 64 images are sent and the text is cut at a character budget; here everything is given.
- The official block header reads `textNone]` when a block has no section label (a typo); here the label is left out.
- One more paragraph at the end of the prompt names the paths; the answer is a file, not a chat reply. The coding-agent adapter puts a newline before a prompt that starts with `-` (the official lead lines open with a list item, which the command line would read as an option, #159).
- Judge: `gpt-5.6-sol` instead of GPT-5.1 (JUDGES A2).

## Published reference scores

Read 2026-11-01, Table 7 of the paper (fast mode, **NeurIPS subset of 46 papers**, injection model GPT-5, judge GPT-5.1): Macro-F1 / EC / FP (%)

| detection model | Macro-F1 | EC | FP |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| GPT-5 | 62.5 | 72.4 | 56.0 |
| Gemini-2.5-Pro | 60.5 | 57.9 | 64.1 |
| Grok-4 | 48.1 | 39.4 | 66.3 |
| Qwen3* (text only) | 45.7 | 43.3 | 49.6 |
| O4-Mini | 45.3 | 45.0 | 48.9 |
| Claude-4.5 | 43.1 | 39.4 | 49.0 |
| GLM-4.6 | 35.5 | 31.5 | 42.4 |

(Source: MANIFEST.yaml `published_scores`. Only Macro-F1 over the same set of papers is comparable; the judges differ.)

## Smoke (Issue #159)

The same paper `paperaudit/iclr25_11848` (Iterative Nash Policy Optimization, 15 applied errors, `--purpose smoke`), once per system, judge `gpt-5.6-sol` (codex-api, `--credential codex=codex`, 1 call each):

| system | run | wall clock | cost (price-list equivalent, nothing charged on a subscription) | F1 | EC | FP |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| CC-sonnet (coding-agent, Claude Code + `claude-sonnet-5-5`, high) | `coding-agent-paperaudit--iclr25_11848-20261101T190333Z` | 169 s | $0.359 | 0.737 | 14/15 | 14/23 |
| RW-sonnet (ResearchWorld, HuTian 4.2.0, `claude-sonnet-5-5`, high) | `researchworld-paperaudit--iclr25_11848-20261101T190210Z` | 1728 s | $3.822 | 0.508 | 15/15 | 15/44 |

The first CC-sonnet run (`coding-agent-paperaudit--iclr25_11848-20261101T190210Z`) failed after 25 seconds: the official lead lines start with `- ` and the command line read the whole prompt as an option. The coding-agent adapter was fixed (a prompt that starts with `-` gets a newline before it, with a test) and the rerun is the row above; the failed run stays in the run list.
Both runs only show that the integration runs through: one paper, one run each, nothing is compared.

# PaperAudit-Bench

中文 | [English](README.en.md)

机器可读的事实在 [`MANIFEST.yaml`](MANIFEST.yaml)；本文只说明读者需要知道的内容，并指出每条事实在 manifest 里的位置。

## 是什么

PaperAudit-Bench 衡量模型能不能在一篇论文里找出被人为注入的错误：从 2025 年 ICLR、ICML、NeurIPS 的 oral 论文里取 220 篇，由 LLM 以“编辑”的方式在全文里注入
约 10 处错误（8 类：证据/数据篡改、方法逻辑、实验设计、引用、结论夸大等，含需要跨章节才能发现的），被测者读改过的论文，交出发现的问题，每条写类别、位置（引原文）和说明。
本项目只用 GPT-5 注入的那一份（数据集里每篇还有 o4-mini 注入的一份，NeurIPS 子集另有六个模型的）：220 篇共 3258 处被应用的错误（每篇 11–18 处）
（来源：MANIFEST.yaml `source.papers`、`source.injected_errors`；论文 arXiv 2601.19916）。

- 论文：arXiv 2601.19916（2026-01-07）。
- 代码：`TU2021/PaperAudit`，固定 commit `de7582b188ca2d867298de978386ec1f5085806f`；**仓库没有许可证文件**。
- 数据：HF 数据集 `mayiwen/PaperAudit_Dataset`，固定 revision `5bfb78951414d014608aeb487992ad0665a6f607`，数据卡标 Apache-2.0。
- 本仓库的数据入口：资产 id `paperaudit-hf`（只取 ICLR_25、ICML_25、NeurIPS_25 三个目录里每篇的 `metadata.json`、`paper_synth_gpt-5-2025-08-07.json`、`reviews.json`、`paper.pdf`，约 1.3 GB，可删除后重建），
  经 `assets/paperaudit-hf` 链接读取（来源：`assets/MANIFEST.yaml`）。

## 许可

数据卡标 Apache-2.0，但数据里转载了 OpenReview 上的论文 PDF、解析出的论文全文和审稿（`reviews.json`），这些是论文作者和审稿人的内容，数据卡的标注不能覆盖他们的权利，数据卡也没有逐篇说明；
代码仓库没有许可证。本项目没有逐篇核对，只经资产把它们用于研究评测，不提交、不再分发；只读代码仓库里的提示和评分函数（来源：MANIFEST.yaml `license`）。

## 题目和批次

220 篇的名单是 manifest 的 `items`，条目名是 `<iclr25|icml25|neurips25>_<OpenReview 编号>`（107 + 67 + 46），例如 `paperaudit/iclr25_10203`。
`uv run researchworld_eval tasks --benchmark paperaudit` 列出它们。

**没有正式批次**：它是阶段三审稿岗位（internal-review）的训练环境（#141、#157），题目由 #157 选定；`src/tasks/batches/paperaudit.yaml` 是全集，不在 `plan.batches` 里。
资源：只要 CPU；每篇一份 Markdown 全文（几十 KB 到约 1 MB）加几张到几十张图。

## 怎么运行和评分

- 官方入口：`detect/mas_error_detection.py` 有三种模式（fast 单次全文审阅、standard 加全文记忆和分章节审阅、deep 多 agent）；评估 `detect/eval_detection.py`（来源：MANIFEST.yaml `run`）。
  本项目对应 fast 模式的全文审阅：系统提示 `PromptTemplates.global_system()`，用户消息是引导行加全部块。
- 评分：LLM 判官看全部注入错误和全部发现，对每个注入错误判断是否被某条发现抓到（可多对多）；每篇：错误覆盖率 EC = 抓到的错误数 / 错误数，发现精确率 FP = 对上的发现数 / 发现数，
  F1 = 二者的调和平均；论文报告各篇 F1 的平均（Macro-F1）。官方判官是 GPT-5.1，本项目由 codex-api 服务的 GPT 担任（`gpt-5.6-sol`），每条分数记实际服务的模型和用量。

## 一道题：交给系统什么、怎么评分（Issue #159）

写作 `paperaudit/<条目>`，任何容器类被测系统都可以运行：

```bash
uv run researchworld_eval run coding-agent paperaudit/iclr25_11848 --condition CC-sonnet --purpose smoke
uv run researchworld_eval providers codex-api start
uv run researchworld_eval score paperaudit-judge <run-id> --credential codex=codex
```

- **给系统的（候选侧，`researchworld_eval.benchmarks.paperaudit` 渲染）**：`SYSTEM.md` 是官方全文审阅的系统提示原文；`TASK.md` 是官方引导行原文，后接一段只说路径的话；
  论文是只读挂载的 `/work/paper/paper.md`（官方的块流，每块一个 `[Block #N | type |Section: S]` 头，图片块写成指向 `images/` 里文件的引用）和 `/work/paper/images/`（从合成文件里内嵌的 base64 解出的图）。
  答案写到 `/work/findings.json`：一个 JSON 对象，键 `findings`，每条恰有 `type`、`section_location`、`error_location`、`explanation`、`confidence`、`proposed_fix`。
- **不给的**：合成文件里的 `audit_log`（编辑清单、应用结果、解释）、原论文 PDF、审稿、元数据、其他注入模型的文件、解析中间文件。渲染只读 `paper.content`；框架拒绝含评测材料名字的候选侧。
- **交付物**：`findings.json`。
- **时间上限**：官方没有时限；这个 benchmark 不设自己的上限，只受框架统一的一周上限约束。
- **联网屏蔽**：fast 模式的检测器没有联网工具，所以是离线题，只放行包索引（共同问题 C4）；屏蔽表（[`shield.yaml`](shield.yaml)）挡数据集页和仓库（答案就在合成文件里）、
  PaperAudit 论文，以及每篇原论文的 OpenReview 论坛页和 PDF 页（`icml25_579` 在数据集里没有 metadata 记录，它的两个论坛是 OpenReview 公开搜索查到的），查得到 arXiv 版本的（184 篇）也挡 arXiv 页；
  文献检索的日期上限取 arXiv v1 与 OpenReview 提交日里较早的一个。论文里印着原标题和作者（官方也是），所以标题不作屏蔽关键词。
- **评分**：评测系统 [`paperaudit-judge`](../../../evaluators/paperaudit_judge/README.md)，主分数 `metrics.f1`，另记 `detection_rate`（EC）和 `precision`（FP）。

### 与官方协议的差异

- 被测者是带工具的 coding agent 或 ResearchWorld，不是一次 API 调用；它可以分段读全文、看图、反复检查。
- 官方一次最多送 64 张图并按字符预算截断全文，这里给全部。
- 官方的块头在没有章节标签时写成 `textNone]`（笔误），这里省掉标签。
- 提示末尾多一段路径说明；答案是文件，不是聊天回复。coding-agent 适配器在以 `-` 开头的提示前加一个换行（官方引导行以列表符开头，否则命令行把它当选项，#159）。
- 判官：`gpt-5.6-sol` 代替 GPT-5.1（JUDGES.md A2）。

## 公开对照分数

读取日 2026-11-01，论文表 7（fast 模式，**NeurIPS 子集 46 篇**，注入模型 GPT-5，判官 GPT-5.1）：Macro-F1 / EC / FP（%）

| 检测模型 | Macro-F1 | EC | FP |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| GPT-5 | 62.5 | 72.4 | 56.0 |
| Gemini-2.5-Pro | 60.5 | 57.9 | 64.1 |
| Grok-4 | 48.1 | 39.4 | 66.3 |
| Qwen3*（非多模态） | 45.7 | 43.3 | 49.6 |
| O4-Mini | 45.3 | 45.0 | 48.9 |
| Claude-4.5 | 43.1 | 39.4 | 49.0 |
| GLM-4.6 | 35.5 | 31.5 | 42.4 |

（来源：MANIFEST.yaml `published_scores`。只有在同一批篇上的 Macro-F1 才可比；判官不同。）

## 冒烟（Issue #159）

同一篇 `paperaudit/iclr25_11848`（Iterative Nash Policy Optimization，15 处被应用的错误，`--purpose smoke`），两个系统各一次，判官 `gpt-5.6-sol`（codex-api，`--credential codex=codex`，各 1 次调用）：

| 系统 | 运行 | 墙钟 | 花费（按价目表折算，订阅无实收） | F1 | EC | FP |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| CC-sonnet（coding-agent，Claude Code + `claude-sonnet-5-5`，high） | `coding-agent-paperaudit--iclr25_11848-20261101T190333Z` | 169 s | $0.359 | 0.737 | 14/15 | 14/23 |
| RW-sonnet（ResearchWorld，HuTian 4.2.0，`claude-sonnet-5-5`，high） | `researchworld-paperaudit--iclr25_11848-20261101T190210Z` | 1728 s | $3.822 | 0.508 | 15/15 | 15/44 |

第一次 CC-sonnet 运行（`coding-agent-paperaudit--iclr25_11848-20261101T190210Z`）25 秒就失败：官方引导行以 `- ` 开头，命令行把整个提示当成了选项。修了 coding-agent 适配器（以 `-` 开头的提示前加一个换行，有测试），重跑才是上表的运行；失败的那次留在运行列表里。
两次都只证明接入走通，不比较系统：一篇一次。

RW-astra and a mixed variant are not added for now.

preinstalled.en: orchestrator image: upstream code at the pin (unmodified), uv-locked dependencies, the docker CLI (a shim adds proxy and CA to sibling containers); agent image: upstream's own agent-cli Dockerfile

notes.benchmark_paths: A benchmark item's paths are mounted into the agent containers unless upstream mounts the same path itself (/workspace and below, /home/agent-home, /task-source, /run, /tmp): those are left out and listed in logs/sibling-mounts.txt. The agents work in upstream's own /workspace (the run directory), so a deliverable the official prompt names under such a path is not written where the run collects it.
notes.venue: paper.paper_format=iclr for every task. The system has only iclr and alife specs and does not choose a venue itself; ICML and NeurIPS templates and a system-chosen venue are unsupported.
notes.task_input: Only the `# Goal` and `# Rubrics` sections of task.md are read: all five candidate files are put under `# Goal` with their headings turned into bold lines; `# Rubrics` carries a neutral line. The paradigm is optimisation of a scalar score: the task-drafting phase (documented as experimental) turns the brief into an evaluator and a seed program.
notes.phases: execution.phases=task_drafting,investigation,final_evaluation,paper; the system's own default also runs ablations and posthoc; final_evaluation stays because a drafted task requires it before the paper. review/revision (second model) are never selected.
notes.agent_pool: agent.pool and agent.models.* are left empty: one model for every phase.
notes.second_provider: No OPENAI/GEMINI key is supplied (concept figures stay in deterministic export mode).
notes.time: No global wall-clock or token cap exists upstream; the runner enforces time_limit_hours. Native caps used: idea cycles=3, per-phase timeouts from [systems.agentic-scientist].
notes.network: Sibling agent containers run on the shield's internal network; the agents keep their CLI WebFetch/Bash network, which go through the shield. Provider hosts are only tunnelled by the shield.
notes.search: Provider server-side web search is switched off in every sibling by the agent CLIs' own system settings, bind-mounted read-only by the docker shim: Claude Code /etc/claude-code/managed-settings.json (permissions.deny WebSearch), Codex /etc/codex/config.toml (web_search="disabled") and /etc/codex/requirements.toml (allowed_web_search_modes=["disabled"]). Upstream's own Semantic Scholar client goes through the shield.
notes.key_exposure: The provider key is in the environment of the agent containers (upstream env-file mechanism) and therefore visible to commands the agent runs. Claude Code's CLAUDE_CODE_SUBPROCESS_ENV_SCRUB=1 was tried and aborts: it needs bubblewrap, which the unmodified upstream agent image lacks.
notes.gpu: gpus=1 is wired (container.gpu_count, harness GPU evaluation) but was not exercised.
notes.docker_socket: The orchestrator has its run's private docker socket; the privileged daemon is root-equivalent.

conditions.notes_en: Added by the maintainer on 2026-11-02 (#185): the GPT-6.1 Sol column of phase 1. Effort is medium, unlike the high of the other conditions (maintainer, 2026-11-04, #227): on the ChatGPT-subscription (Codex login) route OpenAI's backend resets a single request's stream at about 900 s (codex-api answers 500, #223); ARC stage 10 generates all the experiment code in one request, which at high often runs past 15 minutes, and after the cut ARC retries the same request into the same limit. Lowering the effort is a request parameter that sets the experiment condition (precedent: ARC-opus, #106); ARC's prompts, stages and algorithm are untouched.

conditions.notes_en: Added by the maintainer on 2026-11-02 (#185): the GPT-6.1 Sol column of phase 1. EvoScientist's native OpenAI provider with its own OPENAI_BASE_URL pointing at codex-api, on `codex-2`; for a GPT model upstream already sends EVOSCIENTIST_REASONING_EFFORT as reasoning.effort (langchain-openai then uses the Responses API), so no new patch is needed, only environment variables. agent=codex in the condition only means the provider is openai (EvoScientist has no external coding agent).

agent.name: none
agent.how: no external coding agent: EvoScientist's in-process sub-agents (LangChain deepagents)

tools.permissions: think_tool, deepagents built-ins, EvoSkills skills and an execute shell; skill_manager not registered; no search tool

preinstalled.zh: 上游锁定依赖（uv sync --frozen）加兼容补丁 compat.patch；TeX Live（含 fonts-extra、latexmk）；给 agent 用的研究 Python 环境 /opt/research
preinstalled.en: upstream's locked dependencies (uv sync --frozen) plus compat.patch; TeX Live (with fonts-extra and latexmk); a research Python environment for the agent in /opt/research

notes.agent: No external coding agent: EvoScientist runs its own in-process planner/research/code/debug/writing sub-agents (LangChain deepagents) on the one configured model. conditions.agent only selects the provider; Claude Code and Codex are not used.
notes.model: Main agent, sub-agents and EvoScientist's auxiliary calls (tool selector, memory workers, summariser, graders) all use the configured model; auxiliary_model and model_fallbacks are empty.
notes.effort: For the OpenAI provider upstream already takes the effort from EVOSCIENTIST_REASONING_EFFORT (= conditions.effort) and sends it as reasoning.effort; compat.patch (Claude only) is not involved. No max_tokens is set, and codex-api removes max_output_tokens anyway.
notes.paper: The core writes a Markdown report (final_report.md); the EvoSkills paper-writing skill gives a generic LaTeX `article` skeleton with no ICML/ICLR/NeurIPS style and no compile step. The image has TeX Live (latexmk, fonts-extra) but no venue style files; the task asks for an official template, so a venue-formatted PDF depends on the agent obtaining the style through the shield. No extra pipeline stage was added; absent items are listed in result.missing.
notes.tools: skill_manager (git clone of any repository as a skill) is not registered (compat.patch); the Tavily key is not set so tavily_search does not exist; LANGGRAPH_CLI_NO_ANALYTICS=1; EvoSkills is baked in at its pinned commit. The execute shell and the EvoSkills paper-navigator scripts reach the world only through the shield; S2_DATE_CUTOFF is not set (the shield bounds dates).
notes.server_side_search: Not reachable: EvoScientist binds no provider-side search tool to any model (its only tools are think_tool, tavily_search when TAVILY_API_KEY is set, MCP tools from mcp.yaml, deepagents built-ins and skills; EvoScientist/EvoScientist.py:671-672 and 754-755 at the pin; the one bind_tools call is the tool selector's own output schema, middleware/tool_selector.py:166). TAVILY_API_KEY is not passed and the image has no mcp.yaml, so no search tool exists. Anthropic/OpenAI hosts are only tunnelled by the shield, so a provider-side search would be invisible to the audit.
notes.credentials: The container holds only a placeholder in OPENAI_API_KEY and EvoScientist's execute shell inherits it; the shield proxy puts codex-api's local key on the request and the login stays on the host.
notes.memory: A fresh data dir per run (baked skills, empty memory). Memory workers, skill synthesis and the scheduler stay at upstream defaults, so their LLM calls count in the usage log.
notes.limits: async sub-agents off (README advice for scripted runs); recursion_limit=1000000; model retry wait in auto-mode 1800 s (time without progress counts as wall time); execute timeout 300 s per command. No token or cost budget exists.
notes.model_access: the project's own ChatGPT (Codex) login through codex-api  (account ): EvoScientist's native OpenAI provider with its own OPENAI_BASE_URL set to codex-api; upstream sends reasoning={effort, summary: auto} for a GPT model (langchain-openai then uses the Responses API), with the effort from EVOSCIENTIST_REASONING_EFFORT (= conditions.effort); developer-role.patch (RWE_RESPONSES_DEVELOPER_ROLE=1) sends the system prompt as a `developer` message, because the ChatGPT Codex backend answers a `system` message in a Responses input with HTTP 400

meaning.en: EvoScientist; provider openai, reasoning effort high.
